title: FrameflowShortsPlan
description: The moments of one long recording an editor picked to stand on their own as short vertical videos. Each becomes a first cut of its own, so `remove` works like a first cut's removals.

reasoning.description: Optional: how the moments were chosen, and why there are fewer than asked for, if there are.

title.description: A few words naming the moment, for the creator.

hook.description: The opening line, and why it makes someone stop scrolling.

reason.description: Why the moment stands on its own.

remove.description: Spans inside the moment to cut, in order: false starts, repeated takes, long pauses.

confidence.description: Optional; absent means high. "low" when you are not sure the cut is right.
